 On the 3rd at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 1 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between the KT Wiz and the Samsung Lions took place.
 It is a matchup between KT, seeking a combined championship for the first time in five years since the 2021 season combined title, and Samsung, returning to the Korean Series stage for the first time in two years since the 2024 season. On this day, KT started Daniel, and Samsung started Choi Won-tae.
 In the bottom of the fourth inning, Jang Chan-hee took the mound and is pitching with all his might. Nov. 3, 2026
